name: Cichban

attributes.attribute: Irish heroine and one of five wives of Partholón
source that records the arrivals in Ireland
hero and legendary settler of Ireland
one of Partholón's other four wives
also called Dealgnaid, a wife of Partholón

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cichban is an obscure heroine of Irish legend. The Book of Invasions lists her among Partholón's five wives. The other wives were Aife, Nerbgen, and Cerbnat, with Elgnad, also called Dealgnaid, counted among them. Nothing more is told of Cichban anywhere.

okr.objective: Cichban was one of the five wives of the hero Partholón named in the Book of Invasions.
key_results: The Book of Invasions names Cichban as a wife of the hero Partholón.
Her four companion wives were Aife, Elgnad or Deelcaid, Nerbgen, and Cerbnat.
No further detail about Cichban survives in the records.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
